description: Offline transcript-based wake on the WP-7 synthetic PT/FR utterances. Input: docs/evidence/wp7b-stt-hypotheses.json (Parakeet hypotheses of the 32 TTS clips, full utterance). Rule: a token whose accent-free form is within Levenshtein distance D of 'gideon' (length >= 4) counts as the wake name. Positives: the 14 references containing 'Gideon'. Negatives: the 18 without it.
method: scratch script (not versioned): token fuzzy match over the stored hypotheses; no live audio

results.false_hit_example: fr09: 'aider' (Puis-je vous aider avec quelque chose aujourd'hui ?)

misses_at_distance_2: fr16 'Dis donc, arrête la musique maintenant.'
conclusion: Best setting 7/14 (50%) with 0 false triggers; below the 80% bar. Not implemented as a live detector in WP-7b.
